verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs state outright that anything possible in the dashboard can also be done via the Admin/Management API, which covers creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users. An official MCP server and CLI build on that API. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, which does not contradict the parity claim. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the API really matches the UI, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
Purpose: Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
